Nanonets, a startup using AI to automate back-office processes
Nanonets is now on a mission to leverage Deep Learning to build the world's most frictionless business workflow automation platform powered by Autonomous AI Agents.

the startup has built an AI platform through which it offers no-code solutions that, according to the company, can help businesses extract information from documents, emails, tickets, databases and the like, and convert them into actionable insights.

Its no-code AI agents can be plugged into ERP platforms like QuickBooks, Xero, Sage and NetSuite to automate accounts payable processes, optimize supply chains by taking historical data from Square and Tableau, and summarize health reports from patient management systems.

UK startup BidScript has closed an $800,000 funding round as it looks to accelerate the development of its AI-powered tender management platform
The Manchester-headquartered platform helps businesses find, qualify, manage, write and submit bids for public and private sector contracts
Its platform helps organizations manage the entire bidding process, from identifying contract opportunities and assessing eligibility to preparing compliant submissions and managing deadlines.

The platform uses an AI assistant named Biddy that learns from an organization's past submissions, evaluator feedback, and win-loss outcomes to generate evidence-backed draft responses grounded in the company's own knowledge base.
